r2.t: Impelled to rub the forehead, with a kind of insensibility

r4.t: Scalp very sensitive to touch, like a boil

r6.t: Throbbing of arteries, can hardly hold head erect

r7.t: Throbbing of arteries, can hardly hold head erect, and falls asleep

r8.t: Throbbing of arteries, inability to hold up the head

r9.t: Throbbing of arteries, movement of occiput

r10.t: Throbbing of arteries, movement of occiput, grasping it with hands

r11.t: Throbbing of arteries, oftens raises or jerks the head from the pillow

r12.t: Throbbing of arteries, raises up the head

r13.t: Throbbing of arteries, raises up the head, but it constantly falls backwards

r14.t: Throbbing of arteries, raises up the head, but it constantly falls backwards, and the mouth opens to its widest extent

r15.t: Throbbing of arteries, turns head from side to side
